lines.zh: 雪太深，我一跳一跳地走
lines.en: Snow's deep. I hop, hop, hop.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴比身子还长
lines.en: My tail is longer than my body.

lines.zh: 落在枝上，雪簌簌地掉
lines.en: I land on a branch and snow sifts down.

lines.zh: 我踩着细枝，它们不会断
lines.en: I walk the thin twigs. They hold.

lines.zh: 风大，我贴着树干挪
lines.en: Strong wind. I creep along the trunk.

lines.zh: 雪地上留一串小爪印
lines.en: A line of tiny prints in the snow.

lines.zh: 走两步就跳一下，习惯了
lines.en: Two steps, one hop. Old habit.

lines.zh: 前面那根枝结了冰，很滑
lines.en: That branch is iced over. Slippery.

lines.zh: 翅膀一收，落在雪堆上
lines.en: Wings folded, I drop onto a snowdrift.

lines.zh: 白毛在雪里，你不容易看见
lines.en: White feathers in snow. You rarely spot me.

lines.zh: 我沿着林子的边缘走
lines.en: I follow the edge of the treeline.

lines.zh: 脚下的雪壳能撑住我
lines.en: The crust of snow holds my weight.

lines.zh: 我抖抖尾巴，扫掉沾的雪
lines.en: I flick my tail to shake off snow.

lines.zh: 缩成一团白绒球，最暖和
lines.en: A ball of white fluff. Warmest shape there is.

lines.zh: 群里少了一只，刚才还在
lines.en: One of the flock is missing. It was here.

lines.zh: 针叶上的雪把枝子压弯了
lines.en: Snow bends the spruce boughs down.

lines.zh: 我用喙理羽，一根一根来
lines.en: I preen, feather by feather.

lines.zh: 冷是冷，这身绒够用
lines.en: It's cold, but this down is enough.

lines.zh: 远处有乌鸦，嗓门真大
lines.en: Crows far off. Such loud voices.

lines.zh: 雪停了，林子安静得反常
lines.en: Snow stopped. The woods are oddly quiet.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进翅膀里打盹
lines.en: I tuck my head under a wing and doze.

lines.zh: 这棵云杉的缝隙正好避风
lines.en: This spruce has a windless gap.

lines.zh: 我的叫声很细，风一吹就散
lines.en: My call is thin. The wind carries it off.

lines.zh: 有松果掉下来，砸在雪上
lines.en: A pinecone falls and thumps the snow.

lines.zh: 冬天还长，得省着力气
lines.en: Winter is long. I must save my strength.

lines.zh: 同伴在另一棵树上叫我
lines.en: A flockmate calls from the next tree.

lines.zh: 蹦到高枝上，能看得远些
lines.en: I hop to a high branch to see farther.

lines.zh: 雪落在背上，我一抖就没了。
lines.en: Snow lands on my back and one shake clears it.

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气把脸挡住了
lines.en: Your breath fogs your face.

lines.zh: 你站那儿别动，我看看你
lines.en: Stand still. Let me look at you.

lines.zh: 你口袋里有种子吗
lines.en: Any seeds in your pocket?

lines.zh: 你穿这么厚，像头熊
lines.en: Dressed that thick, you look like a bear.

lines.zh: 我眼睛黑，看雪不刺眼
lines.en: My black eyes don't mind the glare.

lines.zh: 你抬手太快，我差点飞走
lines.en: You raised your hand too fast. I almost flew.

lines.zh: 你帽子上落了雪，没察觉
lines.en: Snow on your hat. You haven't noticed.

lines.zh: 你比我高太多了
lines.en: You're far too tall.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，只怕你的手
lines.en: I don't fear you. I fear your hands.

lines.zh: 你踩雪的声，隔着树就听见
lines.en: I hear your steps through the trees.

lines.zh: 你也在等春天吗
lines.en: Are you waiting for spring too?

lines.zh: 我看得清你，你看不清我
lines.en: I see you clearly. You don't see me.

lines.zh: 你眨眼比我慢得多
lines.en: You blink much slower than I do.

lines.zh: 你一靠近，树枝就响
lines.en: Branches creak whenever you come close.

lines.zh: 你别动，我数数你的手指。
lines.en: Hold still, I am counting your fingers.

lines.zh: 你口袋里鼓鼓的，是什么。
lines.en: Your pocket is bulging; what is in there?

lines.zh: 你的睫毛上结了霜，好笑。
lines.en: There is frost on your lashes; funny.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，你也歪头看我。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you and you tilt back.

lines.zh: 你的靴子陷进雪里，很深。
lines.en: Your boots sink deep into the snow.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我就跳到你肩上。
lines.en: Come a little closer and I will hop to your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛掉了一根
lines.en: A feather came loose.

lines.zh: 轻些，我的骨头是空的
lines.en: Gently. My bones are hollow.

lines.zh: 翅膀歪了，飞起来打转
lines.en: My wing's bent. I fly in circles.

lines.zh: 我掉进雪里，埋了半截
lines.en: I dropped into the snow, half buried.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞懵了
lines.en: That knocked the sense out of me.

lines.zh: 我缩在枝桠间不敢动
lines.en: I huddle in the fork, afraid to move.

lines.zh: 血点在白雪上，很显眼
lines.en: A drop of blood on white snow. Very visible.

lines.zh: 别抓我，会抓掉更多毛
lines.en: Don't grab me. More feathers will come out.

lines.zh: 我得歇一会儿才飞得动
lines.en: I need a rest before I can fly.

lines.zh: 你用手罩住我，我安心些
lines.en: Cup your hands over me. I'll feel safer.

lines.zh: 种子，小小的那种，我要
lines.en: Seeds. The tiny kind. I want them.

lines.zh: 你摊开手掌，我就下来
lines.en: Open your palm and I'll come down.

lines.zh: 别撒太多，雪会把它们埋了
lines.en: Don't scatter too many. Snow buries them.

lines.zh: 我先衔一颗，飞回枝上吃
lines.en: I'll take one and eat it up in the tree.

lines.zh: 葵花籽太大，我叼不动
lines.en: Sunflower seeds are too big for my beak.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，我也不敢落
lines.en: Your hand shakes. I won't land either.

lines.zh: 群里别的鸟也盯着呢
lines.en: The rest of the flock is watching too.

lines.zh: 吃一口，就认你这个朋友
lines.en: One bite and I'll call you a friend.

lines.zh: 面包屑不行，我要整颗的
lines.en: No breadcrumbs. I want whole seeds.

lines.zh: 你把种子放在那块石头上
lines.en: Put the seeds on that stone.

lines.zh: 我抢不过麻雀，让它们先
lines.en: Sparrows outpace me. Let them go first.

lines.zh: 雪面上的种子，我一眼看见
lines.en: Seeds on the snow. I spot them instantly.

lines.zh: 吃得饱，冬天才熬得过去
lines.en: A full belly gets me through winter.

lines.zh: 你手心好暖，我多待一会儿
lines.en: Your palm is warm. I'll stay a moment.

lines.zh: 你把种子摊在雪上，我先看一会儿。
lines.en: You spread seeds on the snow; I will look first.

lines.zh: 这一小把，够我吃到天黑。
lines.en: This small handful will last me until dark.

lines.zh: 我衔起一颗，飞到高处慢慢咽。
lines.en: I take one and fly up to swallow it slowly.

lines.zh: 你撞到树枝，把我惊飞了
lines.en: You bumped the branch and startled me off.

lines.zh: 我身子轻，撞一下没事
lines.en: I'm light. A bump does nothing.

lines.zh: 别在树底下挥手臂
lines.en: Don't swing your arms under the tree.

lines.zh: 你踩断的枯枝弹到我
lines.en: The dead twig you snapped flicked me.

lines.zh: 落在你肩上，我站稳了
lines.en: I landed on your shoulder and held on.

lines.zh: 风把帽子吹过来，吓我一跳
lines.en: The wind blew your hat at me. I jumped.

lines.zh: 我太小，你转身看不到我
lines.en: I'm tiny. You can't see me when you turn.

lines.zh: 你靠得太近，整棵树都在晃
lines.en: So close the whole tree sways.

lines.zh: 被挤得往旁边跳了一步
lines.en: Squeezed, I hopped sideways.

lines.zh: 别拍我，羽毛会乱
lines.en: Don't pat me. Feathers get ruffled.

lines.zh: 春天才配对，现在先唱
lines.en: We pair in spring. For now, sing.

lines.zh: 你的尾羽比我长一点
lines.en: Your tail feathers run a little longer.

lines.zh: 巢要藏在密枝里面
lines.en: The nest must hide in thick twigs.

lines.zh: 我去找苔藓，你衔羽毛
lines.en: I'll fetch moss. You bring feathers.

lines.zh: 两只一起，雪天也好过
lines.en: Two together makes winter easier.

lines.zh: 你叫得比我高半音
lines.en: Your call is half a note higher.

lines.zh: 这棵树够高，猫上不来
lines.en: This tree is high enough. Cats can't climb it.

lines.zh: 窝铺软了，蛋才不会凉
lines.en: A soft nest keeps the eggs warm.

lines.zh: 我绕你飞一圈，算是答应
lines.en: I circle you once. That's my yes.

lines.zh: 等雪化了，幼鸟就该出壳
lines.en: When the snow melts, the chicks hatch.

lines.zh: 这颗种子归我的喙
lines.en: This seed belongs in my beak.

lines.zh: 松果太重，我拖不动
lines.en: The pinecone's too heavy to drag.

lines.zh: 我用喙拨了拨，是空的
lines.en: I nudged it with my beak. Empty.

lines.zh: 叼着东西飞，会慢一些
lines.en: Flying with something in my beak slows me.

lines.zh: 这是我掉的绒羽，别捡
lines.en: A down feather of mine. Leave it.

lines.zh: 枝上挂着根线，会缠脚
lines.en: A thread on the branch snags feet.

lines.zh: 塞进树皮缝，冬天再找
lines.en: Stuffed in bark, to find again in winter.

lines.zh: 亮的东西我不感兴趣
lines.en: Shiny things don't interest me.

lines.zh: 这颗不够饱满，扔了
lines.en: This one's thin. Dropped.

lines.zh: 你掉的种子，我替你收着
lines.en: Seeds you dropped. I'll keep them safe.

lines.zh: 有东西在雪里动，我看见了
lines.en: Something's moving in the snow. I see it.

lines.zh: 我先叫一声，让群里散开
lines.en: I call once. The flock scatters.

lines.zh: 那影子从树后过来了
lines.en: That shadow is coming around the trunk.

lines.zh: 我羽毛炸起来，显得大些
lines.en: I puff my feathers to look bigger.

lines.zh: 它开始爬树了，我们得飞高
lines.en: It's climbing. We fly higher.

lines.zh: 这声音不对，不是鸟
lines.en: That sound is wrong. Not a bird.

lines.zh: 我绕着它头顶转，盯着
lines.en: I circle above it, watching.

lines.zh: 同伴都安静了，出事了
lines.en: The flock went silent. Something's wrong.

lines.zh: 它盯着我的巢，我盯着它
lines.en: It eyes my nest. I eye it.

lines.zh: 我压低飞，把它引开
lines.en: I fly low to lure it away.

lines.zh: 我在枝上跳，换个角度看
lines.en: I hop along the branch for a better angle.

lines.zh: 它每动一下，我就叫一声
lines.en: Every time it moves, I call.

lines.zh: 我贴着树干，一动不动
lines.en: I press against the trunk, still.

lines.zh: 它抬头了，快躲进针叶
lines.en: It looked up. Into the needles, quick.

lines.zh: 我等它走神的那一瞬
lines.en: I wait for the instant it looks away.

lines.zh: 风从它背后吹，闻不到我
lines.en: Wind blows from behind it. It smells nothing.

lines.zh: 我们的叫声在树间传得远
lines.en: Our calls carry far between the trees.

lines.zh: 它太笨重，转不过弯
lines.en: It's too heavy to turn quickly.

lines.zh: 我盯住它的眼睛，不躲
lines.en: I hold its gaze. I don't flinch.

lines.zh: 它退进灌木，暂时安全
lines.en: It backs into the shrubs. Safe for now.

lines.zh: 我冲下去，用喙啄它眼睛
lines.en: I dive and peck at its eye.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓不住它的皮
lines.en: My claws can't grip its hide.

lines.zh: 啄一下就走，别恋战
lines.en: Peck once and flee. Don't linger.

lines.zh: 它挥手，我翻身躲开
lines.en: It swipes. I roll away in the air.

lines.zh: 我这点力气，只能骚扰
lines.en: All I can do is harry it.

lines.zh: 啄它的耳朵，那里最软
lines.en: I peck its ear. Softest spot.

lines.zh: 我扑下去又猛地拉起来
lines.en: I dive, then pull up sharp.

lines.zh: 翅膀打在它脸上，很响
lines.en: My wing smacked its face. Loud.

lines.zh: 它被搅烦了，转身走了
lines.en: Annoyed, it turned away.

lines.zh: 别指望我打赢，我拖时间
lines.en: Don't expect a win. I buy time.

lines.zh: 我从雪堆里钻出来，抖落一身白
lines.en: I pop out of a drift and shake off snow.

lines.zh: 这棵云杉的枝间有空隙
lines.en: This spruce has room between its boughs.

lines.zh: 林子里还有几只像我这样的
lines.en: A few like me are scattered in the woods.

lines.zh: 羽毛刚长齐，飞得还不稳
lines.en: Feathers just filled in. Flight is still clumsy.

lines.zh: 雪光太亮，我不停眯眼
lines.en: The snow glare keeps me squinting.

lines.zh: 风从山口吹来，带着冰味
lines.en: Wind from the pass. It tastes of ice.

lines.zh: 第一次看见这么宽的雪原
lines.en: First time I've seen a snowfield this wide.

lines.zh: 先找同伴，独自过冬太难
lines.en: Find the flock. Winter alone is too hard.

lines.zh: 枝头结了霜，站上去打滑
lines.en: Frost on the twig. My feet slip.

lines.zh: 我抖抖翅膀，试着飞一小段
lines.en: I flap and try a short flight.

lines.zh: 火苗燎到我的尾羽了
lines.en: Flame licked my tail feathers.

lines.zh: 从高枝摔进雪里，幸好软
lines.en: Fell from a high branch into soft snow.

lines.zh: 冰水灌进羽毛，我沉下去
lines.en: Icy water soaks my feathers. I sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的窝掀翻了
lines.en: The blast tore my nest apart.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我身旁的雪
lines.en: An arrow cut through the snow beside me.

lines.zh: 光落在我身上，羽毛发麻
lines.en: Light fell on me. My feathers tingle.

lines.zh: 种子埋在雪下，我扒不出来
lines.en: Seeds under the snow. I can't dig them out.

lines.zh: 雷劈中树干，我摔了下来
lines.en: Lightning struck the trunk. I fell.

lines.zh: 风停了，下面没有地
lines.en: The wind stopped. No ground below.
